style: Style: hand-drawn 2D vintage educational cartoon, bold slightly imperfect dark brown outlines, rounded hand-inked linework, flat colors with minimal cel shading, warm peach skin (warm brown with peach highlights for Indian characters), palette of deep navy blue and warm muted gold accents with soft browns and cream, low saturation, vintage textbook look with clean digital coloring. Plain flat warm cream-beige background (#F5F1E8), no scenery, figures centered with generous space around them. No text, no letters, no signs, no labels. Not photorealistic, not 3D, not anime, not Pixar, not watercolor. No extra objects, no extra fingers.
